## Statements

- Stated by harness (qwen-code-headless, line 889-894, Safety in unattended runs): qwen -p with --yolo approves every tool call and does not turn on a sandbox; pair it with -s or QWEN_SANDBOX, or the tools run with the host's privileges.
- Stated by harness (qwen-code-headless, line 858-875, --max-* options; line 896-899, Run-level budgets): Unattended runs can be bounded with --max-session-turns, --max-wall-time, and --max-tool-calls; each is unlimited by default, so set one for delegated work.
- Stated by harness (qwen-code-approval, line 336-348, Default and Quick Reference Guide; qwen-code-headless line 839-851): --approval-mode takes plan, default, auto-edit, auto, or yolo. The out-of-the-box mode is auto, while the value named default means ask for each edit and command.
- Stated by harness (qwen-code-providers, line 583-593, Override reasoning capabilities): Qwen Code has no per-run effort flag. Reasoning tiers and the default come from capabilities.reasoning on the model entry in settings, so set them when defining a custom route.
